Method of Attack: info-stealing malware distributing custom JavaScript code to collect device fingerprints and credentials
collecting device fingerprints (cookies, IP addresses, time zones, device info), saved passwords, and persona details
impersonation of victim machines logging into services using stolen credentials and device fingerprints
Impacted Systems: consumer accounts (Gmail, Facebook, Netflix, Spotify, WordPress, PayPal, Reddit, Amazon, LinkedIn, Cloudflare, Twitter, eBay)
Attack Vector: bots rented to provide stolen account identities in real-time
Indicators of Compromise: Genesis Market marketplace domains seized in Operation Cookie Monster
Genesis Market platform offering about 80 million credentials and digital fingerprints
Genesis Market package including source code, scripts, server infrastructure, and database
